hypotheses.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
hypotheses.fit_reason: The recursive defaults function can be exploited to pollute the Object prototype through attacker-controlled keys, as evidenced by the mechanism of recursive object assignment and lack of prototype checks.

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
hypotheses.fit_reason: Prototype pollution can lead to XSS if polluted properties are later used in web page generation, especially when the polluted prototype is used in template rendering or dynamic code execution.
The recursive nature of defaults can be abused to cause excessive object manipulation, leading to resource exhaustion if not properly bounded.
